text: Burak Çetin поделился(ась) публикацией участника Renad BinTaleb : While working through our HITL setup, I kept coming back to one thing, how can several parts of a system look fine while the behavior we expect from it is still missing? build target that wasn't there, Serial interface that wasn't available, ROS 2 graph without the expected data. None of these explained the whole picture on their own. What I found interesting was trying to understand how they were connected breaking the system down, looking at what I actually knew versus what I was assuming, testing different possibilities, and keeping track of what each result was telling me. I wrote about the investigation, what it changed in the way I look at complex systems, and what I want to take with me into the next one. PX4 → uORB → Micro XRCE-DDS → Agent → DDS → ROS 2 tracing the data path, isolating the failure boundary, validating assumptions, and understanding why the expected topics never reached ROS 2. #Robotics #AutonomousSystems #PX4 #ROS2 #UAV #SaudiArabia

Il corso offre agli studenti e studentesse una serie di attività pratiche di prove di volo preparate, coordinate ed eseguite con il supporto di professionisti esperti provenienti da enti e aziende del settore. In ogni missione, uno studente o studentessa ha svolto il ruolo di Flight Test Engineer (FTE), guidando l'attività in cabina di pilotaggio affiancato da personale altamente qualificato dell'azienda. - The Flight Testing course of the M.Sc. in Aeronautical Engineering at Politecnico di Milano was mentioned by the Society of Flight Test Engineers (SFTE) - one of the world’s leading organizations dedicated to flight testing - as a "Recommended Practice." The course offers enrolled students a range of practical flight test activities, prepared, coordinated and carried out with the support of expert professionals from external organizations and companies in the sector. During each mission, a student takes on the role of Flight Test Engineer (FTE), leading the activity in the cockpit alongside highly qualified company personnel. text: Организация Saildrone разместила контент: The Chukchi Sea is one of the most demanding maritime environments in the world: Freezing temperatures, rough seas, ice, and extreme remoteness make sustained operations difficult and expensive—particularly when crews and ships have to remain on station for extended periods. Saildrone is operating there now, extending observation into areas where persistent presence is otherwise difficult to maintain. And occasionally, the onboard cameras capture something unexpected. These walruses were filmed recently during operations offshore of Alaska—at a respectful distance, of course. A fun reminder of what persistent maritime awareness can reveal when you are watching places that are otherwise very difficult to reach..
